description:
**Phase C — Pure compaction core. Deps: C1, C2, C3, B6.**

Port `prepareCompaction` from `tmp/pi-mono/.../compaction/compaction.ts:614-689`.

Sequence:
1. Guard against re-compacting last entry (compaction.ts:618-619).
2. Scan back for previous `CompactionEntry` — extract `previous_summary` and `boundary_start = first_kept_entry_id`.
3. Recompute `tokens_before` from rebuilt context via B6's `build_session_context/2` (NOT from trigger-time value).
4. Call `find_cut_point` (C2).
5. Slice `messages_to_summarize` and (if split) `turn_prefix_messages`.
6. Accumulate `file_ops` from messages + previous entry's `details` (skip if `from_hook?: true` — pi-mono compaction.ts:41-69).

Returns `%CompactionPreparation{first_kept_entry_id, messages_to_summarize, turn_prefix_messages, is_split_turn?, tokens_before, previous_summary, file_ops, settings}`.

Tests: port the prep cases from `agent-session-compaction.test.ts`.
title: C5. Compaction.prepare/2 → %CompactionPreparation{}
